mil3.4.3:1.2: “Venerable Nāgasena, these five sense fields—were they produced by various deeds, or by one deed?”
mil3.4.3:1.3: “They were produced by various deeds, Great King, not by one deed.”
mil3.4.3:2.2: “What do you think, Great King: if various seeds were sown in one field, would various fruits be produced from those various seeds?”
mil3.4.3:2.4: “In the same way, Great King, each of the five sense fields was produced by various deeds, not by one deed.”
